standard_prerequisites: The projection formula and the computation of the pushforward of powers of the first Chern class of the tautological quotient by the projection, which makes the universal combination the identity on the base
Chow groups with rational equivalence for locally finite sums of cycles, and the exact sequences relating the Chow groups of a space, an open subspace and the preimage of its complement
The reduction of statements about algebraic spaces to schemes along a quasi-compact open, and the scheme case of the projective bundle formula
core_obligations: Injectivity: assume a combination of the pullbacks of the components maps to zero, apply the pushforward and the Chern class computation to read off that the last component vanishes, then multiply by the Chern class and repeat to obtain that every component vanishes
Surjectivity: follow the reduction of the affine fibration lemma to pass to schemes

Write the class as a finite linear combination of classes of pairwise distinct integral closed subspaces, take their images in the base, verify local finiteness of the images and of the intersections with the preimage of a quasi-compact open, and observe that it suffices to prove the statement on the fibre products over the images, since the locally finite sums on the base then reassemble

Reduce to the case where the base is integral and the class is the class of a single integral closed subspace dominating the base, so that the dimension of the base is finite and induction on it is available
Base case: if the dimension of the base is below the required threshold then the relevant Chow group vanishes and the statement is immediate

Induction step: work over a nonempty open subspace, lift the components found there to cycles on the whole base, use the exact sequence for the complement to write the difference as a class supported on the preimage of the complement, which has smaller dimension, and conclude by induction; finally shrink to a scheme and quote the scheme case
proof_roadmap: Prove injectivity by applying the pushforward identity and its multiples with the Chern class
Reduce surjectivity to the case of an integral base and a single dominating integral closed subspace
Run the induction on the dimension of the base using an open subspace, the exact sequence for the complement and the lifting of cycles
Shrink to a scheme and quote the scheme case of the formula
difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the projective space bundle formula at source lines 4380-4403, label lemma-chow-ring-projective-bundle, whose proof occupies source lines 4405-4512. The two halves are different in kind. Injectivity is a short computation that must be iterated: the pushforward of the universal combination returns the top component, and multiplying by the Chern class before pushing forward strips one component at a time. Surjectivity is a reduction and induction: the class is decomposed into classes of integral closed subspaces, the statement is proved on the fibre products over their images and reassembled through locally finite sums, which reduces to an integral base and a single dominating subspace, and the induction on the dimension of the base shrinks to an open subspace, lifts cycles from the open and disposes of the difference through the exact sequence of the complement before quoting the scheme case. The counted statement records neither the induction nor the decomposition.
